set -eu

NAMESPACE="core-omero-prod"

now_minutes=$((10#$(TZ="$TIMEZONE" date +%H) * 60 + 10#$(TZ="$TIMEZONE" date +%M)))
day=$(TZ="$TIMEZONE" date +%u)

time_to_minutes() {
  value="$1"
  hour="${value%%:*}"
  minute="${value##*:}"
  echo $((10#$hour * 60 + 10#$minute))
}

should_run() {
  start="$1"
  stop="$2"
  days="$3"

  case ",$days," in
    *",$day,"*) ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac

  start_minutes=$(time_to_minutes "$start")
  stop_minutes=$(time_to_minutes "$stop")

  if [ "$start_minutes" -lt "$stop_minutes" ]; then
    [ "$now_minutes" -ge "$start_minutes" ] &&
    [ "$now_minutes" -lt "$stop_minutes" ]
  else
    [ "$now_minutes" -ge "$start_minutes" ] ||
    [ "$now_minutes" -lt "$stop_minutes" ]
  fi
}

ensure_scale() {
  deployment="$1"
  replicas="$2"

  current=$(
    oc get deployment "$deployment" \
      -n "$NAMESPACE" \
      -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}'
  )

  if [ "$current" != "$replicas" ]; then
    echo "$deployment: $current -> $replicas"

    oc scale deployment "$deployment" \
      -n "$NAMESPACE" \
      --replicas="$replicas"
  else
    echo "$deployment: already $replicas"
  fi
}

echo "Current day: $day"
echo "Current minutes: $now_minutes"

if should_run "$OMERO_START" "$OMERO_STOP" "$OMERO_DAYS"; then
  echo "Scaling up web and server..."
  ensure_scale omero-server 1
  ensure_scale omero-web 1
  oc rollout status deployment/omero-server -n core-omero-prod --timeout=10m
  oc rollout status deployment/omero-web -n core-omero-prod --timeout=10m
  echo "Scaling up succesfull."
  echo "Removing OMERO maintanance flag..."
  oc patch configmap maintenance-mode -n core-omero-prod --type=merge -p '{"data":{"omero.flag":null}}'
else
  echo "Enabling OMERO maintenance mode..."
  oc patch configmap maintenance-mode -n core-omero-prod --type=merge -p '{"data":{"omero.flag":"on"}}'
  ensure_scale omero-web 0
  ensure_scale omero-server 0
fi

if should_run "$FLASK_START" "$FLASK_STOP" "$FLASK_DAYS"; then
  echo "Scaling up Flask app..."
  ensure_scale flask-app 1
  oc rollout status deployment/flask-app -n core-omero-prod --timeout=10m
  echo "Scaling up succesfull."
  oc patch configmap maintenance-mode -n core-omero-prod --type=merge -p '{"data":{"flask.flag":null}}'
else
  echo "Enabling FLASK maintenance mode..."
  oc patch configmap maintenance-mode -n core-omero-prod --type=merge -p '{"data":{"flask.flag":"on"}}'
  ensure_scale flask-app 0
fi

if should_run "$DASHBOARD_START" "$DASHBOARD_STOP" "$DASHBOARD_DAYS"; then
  echo "Scaling up dashboard..."
  dashboard_replicas=$(oc get deployment dashboard-django -n "$NAMESPACE" -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')
  if [ "$dashboard_replicas" -eq 0 ]; then
    ensure_scale dashboard-django 1
  else
    echo "dashboard-django: already running with $dashboard_replicas replica(s)"
  fi
  oc rollout status deployment/dashboard-django -n core-omero-prod --timeout=10m
  echo "Scaling up succesfull."
  oc patch configmap maintenance-mode -n core-omero-prod --type=merge -p '{"data":{"dashboard.flag":null}}'
else
  echo "Enabling DASHBOARD maintenance mode..."
  oc patch configmap maintenance-mode -n core-omero-prod --type=merge -p '{"data":{"dashboard.flag":"on"}}'
  ensure_scale dashboard-django 0
fi
